title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Guarded RepeatM Benchmark
command: Apply a tmp-only VDCores guarded RepeatM patch on the H200 baseline checkout, rebuild without DAE_DEBUG_PRINT using the selected Qwen3-1.7B compute-op list, run one full offline launch, then run DAE_BENCH_WARMUP=1 python app/python/qwen3_1p7b/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache> -N 1 -b 5 with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1.
observation: The guarded RepeatM patch skips addr_accum shuffles until RepeatM is active and the source lane is valid. The full one-token launch returned status 0, and the 5-iteration benchmark returned status 0 on 132 H200 SMs with median execution time 1778528 ns and average execution time 1779008 ns.

resource_policy.guard_patch: skip addr_accum shuffle unless RepeatM is active and source lane is valid
resource_policy.writeback_wait_patch: wait for writeback slot flags after allocation for PC48/PC55 hazards

rules_out: VDCores logits-stage failure as a blocker after guarding invalid pre-repeat shuffle
Hugging Face model access as a blocker when offline cache flags are used
remaining_paper_gaps: run single-token correctness on the guarded patch
capture queue-pressure and scheduler-overhead metadata comparable to PTO persistent_device and MPK
repeat latency distributions on the final patched baseline policy before paper use
summary.next_debug_target: run guarded VDCores correctness and add queue/resource-policy trace fields instead of only launcher profile timing
summary.root_cause_supported: unguarded addr_accum shuffle executes with invalid source lane before RepeatM decode at PC49; guarding it lets the full one-token launch and 5-iteration benchmark complete.
